Hi team —

I'm pulling together a short intake playbook for promotion/level-change packets so we have one canonical handoff and conflict-check process when managers send packet drafts. Goal is to reduce back-and-forth and make redaction ownership explicit before the committee window.

Key asks:
- Can each of you confirm who will own step 3 (redaction verification) and step 5 (final approver signoff) by EOD Tue?
- Monica: can you seed the packet template with the new evidence checklist and share as a PDF?
- Vanessa: please flag any blackout windows for your team between Aug 17–28.
- Markus: legal will likely need the candidate summary IFO language — do you want to loop External Legal now or only at final review?

I attached a quick draft playbook (intake_playbook_v1.md) and a packet draft skeleton (packet_draft_v1.pdf) to illustrate the flow.

Thanks — this should make committee intake smoother and reduce last-minute redaction work.

-David
